limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The field-trace/separability criterion is standard prior art. The correction concerns the arbitrary-field quadratic-extension branch and dependent centroid statements; the finite-field T-ideal theorems are not contradicted because finite fields are perfect. No T-ideal basis is claimed for the newly exposed inseparable family. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: A sharp separability correction to the quadratic-field branch of the arbitrary-field classification of two-dimensional trace-prime algebras in arXiv:2609.19797v1.
record_title: Purely inseparable correction to quadratic trace-algebra classification
